taco_coco_raw_audit_finding.categories_falsely_claimed_previously: Category 60 (Batteries), Category 63/64 (Organic/Food waste) DO NOT EXIST in official TACO COCO dataset.

actual_battery_in_taco.name: Battery
actual_battery_in_taco.note_on_splits: taco_0456 is in Train split (1 box). taco_0082 is in Test split (1 cylindrical Panasonic battery, strictly protected). taco_0499 was a typographical error in earlier draft; it contains Category 45 disposable food container (plastic).

taco_coco_raw_audit_finding.conclusion: Official TACO is already 100% ingested into CNTT-KLCN155. It contains ZERO additional battery or food waste instances. Sourcing 40 batteries and 50 biological instances from TACO is completely impossible.
